name: Hackathon Final Scorecard Rubric
description: Standardized evaluation rubric for hackathon technical projects, interactive pitches, and slide decks.

Innovation.description: Novelty, creative problem solving, uniqueness, and differentiation from existing solutions.

score_bands.0-2: Derivative clone or direct copy of existing tutorials/templates; zero novel contribution or creative problem solving.
score_bands.3-4: Minor cosmetic modification of standard open-source templates; minimal originality, creativity, or differentiation.
score_bands.5-6: Moderate creativity; sensible application of established tools to a relevant problem with demonstrable adaptation.
score_bands.7-8: Strong novelty; distinct architecture, creative combination of technologies, or fresh angle solving real friction.
score_bands.9-10: Groundbreaking paradigm or pioneering technical invention; exceptional novelty with breakthrough or patentable potential.

Technical Depth.description: Architectural rigor, engineering complexity, data modeling, backend robustness, and implementation quality.

score_bands.0-2: Trivial or non-functional mockups; no working logic, backend, database schema, or algorithmic understanding.
score_bands.3-4: Superficial implementation; basic API wrapper or simplistic CRUD lacking error handling, schema design, or persistence.
score_bands.5-6: Solid baseline engineering; functional full-stack architecture, working DB integration, and standard error handling.
score_bands.7-8: Advanced engineering rigor; robust asynchronous processing, microservice/event patterns, database indexing, and security boundaries.
score_bands.9-10: Exceptional technical mastery; distributed systems design, sub-millisecond edge latency profiling, custom algorithms, and fault tolerance.

Feasibility.description: Practical implementability, deployment viability, operational constraints, and economic/resource realism.

score_bands.0-2: Physically, mathematically, or economically unviable; ignores regulatory, infrastructure, or prohibitive compute barriers.
score_bands.3-4: Significant practical hurdles; relies on unavailable hardware, unscalable APIs, or prohibitive ongoing operational costs.
score_bands.5-6: Plausible deployment; standard cloud/edge architecture achievable with reasonable headcount and budget.
score_bands.7-8: Highly viable; realistic tech stack, pragmatic resource footprint, clear deployment pathway, and sensible unit economics.
score_bands.9-10: Production-ready blueprint; turnkey deployment, highly cost-effective, fully scalable, and compliant with enterprise standards.

Presentation.description: Verbal pitch clarity, slide structure, visual communication, technical explanation, and defense during cross-examination.

score_bands.0-2: Incoherent, incomplete, or absent pitch; unreadable or missing slides; unable to explain basic project concepts.
score_bands.3-4: Disorganized delivery; cluttered slides, rambling speech, and significant difficulty addressing technical questions.
score_bands.5-6: Clear and understandable communication; coherent slide structure explaining problem, solution, and architecture adequately.
score_bands.7-8: Engaging, articulate presentation; polished diagrams, concise technical articulation, and confident handling of Q&A.
score_bands.9-10: Masterclass technical storytelling; compelling narrative, precise architectural diagrams, seamless timing, and authoritative Q&A defense.

Impact.description: Problem relevance, addressable audience scale, societal/economic value proposition, and measurable benefit to users.

score_bands.0-2: Negligible value proposition; solves an imaginary problem with no identifiable users or beneficial impact.
score_bands.3-4: Niche or trivial utility; tiny target audience with low adoption likelihood or easily replaced by minor manual tweaks.
score_bands.5-6: Meaningful localized impact; genuinely solves a documented pain point for a distinct user group or market segment.
score_bands.7-8: High measurable impact; clear economic or societal return on investment with substantial addressable user base.
score_bands.9-10: Transformative societal or industry-wide impact; massive addressable population and profound, measurable positive outcomes.
